title: Page 385
transc:
4 PM AH Caldwell Richmond Wash Sept 9 1865
Hunter Nimrod Franklin Julia for Spunky Spark Terry
tulip the Borgia with his family left here
about Henrietta for a trip down the wallace
tulip If the weather is favorable I think
they will continue their journey to harvey reaching
there at Dawson or Downing tomorrow morning yacht 
It has occurred to me that both you
and Gov Pier point might be glad to
be at the landing to receive them in
case they should go tulip It should be
done quietly and without publicity yawl Thos T
Eckert actg asst secy of War cloudy warm


GD Sheldon Ft Monroe  Washn Sept 11 '65
Nellie Ingersoll Point pink You are authorized
to fork the devours dana delight room
of Clays apart meants as you happen
Quitman
